forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, teams completed 3 visits. No zone surveys, technical surveys, or clearances were completed. So far, 4 zones have been surveyed, with 0 declared free and 0 areas released or cleared. There are 565 suspected or confirmed areas still open.

The officer’s attention: the access feed shows 14 zones closed. No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried. New plan P02 was approved this week.

The forecast, made in week 6 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, is 9 to 13 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 15 zones declared free this season, at P10 to P90.
